select * from OM.OM_TASK_RUN where task_name like '%FCFTT%' and process_date='2024-01-02'
SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS='FOR RE-EXECUTION'
SELECT *
FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN
WHERE (
		   TASK_NAME LIKE '%_DEP_FCFTT%'
		OR TASK_NAME LIKE '%_DEP_FCFTT%'
		)
	AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), PROCESS_DATE, 112) >= 20240102
	AND DATA_LAYER LIKE '%EDS%'
